_comment: Valuation gate data. IPS 3a. Every BUY must have an entry here with gate PASS, or the engine refuses the order. All figures from stockanalysis.com as of 2026-08-14 unless noted. 'ga_multiple' = forward P/E divided by the better of EPS growth or revenue growth.

_gate_rules.flag_if_forward_pe_above_trailing: consensus expects EPS to fall; requires explicit comment
_gate_rules.turnaround_method: When trailing growth is negative or distorted, derive implied forward EPS growth from (trailing P/E / forward P/E) - 1 and use that for the growth-adjusted multiple. Documented so it cannot be applied selectively to rescue a name I like.
_gate_rules.pre_profit: Unprofitable/pre-revenue names are exempt from the P/E gate and are governed by the Moonshot screen (IPS 1). Status MOONSHOT-CLEARED = screen satisfied and buyable; MOONSHOT-PENDING = not yet cleared and NOT buyable.

MU.note: Cheapest forward multiple on the desk by a wide margin. The market is pricing peak-cycle memory earnings as a trap, which is the standard memory discount. Risk is that it is right.

TSM.note: Management guiding FY26 revenue growth slightly above 40% in USD.

NVDA.note: Cheapest growth on the desk. Holds a disclosed $21B stake in SpaceX and is the compute partner for Starmind AI1.

AMD.note: Passes, but it is the richest forward multiple among the AI compute names. Size reduced accordingly.

VRT.note: Scrapes past the 15% upside floor at 15.08%. Sized small because of it.

MSFT.note: Exactly at the 15% upside floor. Passes on the growth-adjusted multiple comfortably.

GOOGL.note: Forward P/E (26.07) sits ABOVE trailing (17.38), so trailing EPS of $19.93 (+112.5%) is inflated by non-recurring items. Judged on the forward number, which still passes. Best value in the Core book.

JPM.note: REJECTED. Cheap on multiple (15.03x forward, 0.77 growth-adjusted) but only 3.23% implied upside to consensus - the second-worst on the desk after ETN. A low multiple is not an opportunity when the whole street already agrees it is worth roughly what it costs.

XLV.note: Sector ETF. Single-name valuation metrics do not apply; the gate is not meaningful here.

GEV.note: REJECTED. Forward P/E 49.31 sits ABOVE trailing 30.03 - consensus expects EPS to FALL, because trailing net income (+724% y/y) is not repeatable. Lowest revenue growth on the desk (+13%) at the highest forward multiple. Growth-adjusted 3.79 vs the 2.0 limit. An independent DCF puts pure fair value at $295-491; the blended base case is $1,019 against a $1,063 price. Adjusted EPS missed consensus by ~19% last quarter DESPITE a revenue beat - the backlog-to-earnings conversion is precisely the weak point. Wind orders -40% y/y. The $176B backlog is the most public fact about this company and 38 analysts have modeled it.

ETN.note: REJECTED. Only 4.11% implied upside to consensus - far below the 15% floor and the worst on the entire desk. Trailing EPS is NEGATIVE year over year (-1.2%) while paying 30.72x forward. The data center demand story is real and entirely in the price.

COST.note: REJECTED. 43.89x forward for 9.2% revenue growth. Growth-adjusted 3.43 vs the 2.0 limit, and 12.09% upside is below the floor. I flagged in the original thesis that it was persistently expensive and sized it down instead of acting on that. The gate says size-down was the wrong response - don't own it.

LIN.note: REJECTED. A wonderful business at a full price. 25.82x forward against 10.2% EPS growth and 3.0% revenue growth gives 2.53 vs the 2.0 limit, and 13.28% upside misses the floor. Quality is not a valuation argument.

RKLB.note: Unprofitable, so the valuation gate does not apply - IPS 3a exempts pre-revenue/pre-profit names, which are governed by the Moonshot screen instead. Currently 2 of 4 Moonshot criteria verified (analyst conviction 40.8% upside across 18 Buys; sector catalysts dated). Smart-money accumulation and sentiment acceleration NOT yet verified. Not bought. Screened properly in the September cycle. Note it trades 47% below its 52-week high of $151.00, so it is not disqualified for having already run.

META.note: Strongest pass on the desk outside the AI book. 18.58x forward, forward BELOW trailing (earnings expected to rise), 27.7% revenue growth, 27.9% upside. Cheap, growing, and with room to the target.

AMZN.note: FLAG: forward P/E 28.54 sits above trailing 21.32, so trailing net income (+91.6%) is inflated by non-recurring items. Judged on the forward number. 1.81 growth-adjusted is inside the 2.0 limit but it is the least comfortable pass in the Core book.

UNH.note: EDGE CASE, handled explicitly. Trailing EPS is -32.8% y/y, which would fail a naive growth-adjusted test on a depressed base. But forward P/E (18.88) sits BELOW trailing (25.86), implying ~37% forward EPS recovery, and the company just beat and RAISED its outlook. Growth-adjusted computed off implied forward growth = 0.51. This is the documented method for turnarounds: when trailing growth is negative or distorted, derive implied forward growth from the trailing/forward P/E ratio.

CBRS.note: Pre-profit (Q1 2026 core net loss $(2.5)M), so the P/E-based gate in IPS 3a does not apply — you cannot compute a multiple on earnings that do not exist. Governed by the Moonshot screen in IPS 1 instead, which it satisfies: revenue +94% y/y verified at IR, FY26 core revenue guided $855-865M (+69%), a $20B+ 750MW OpenAI agreement as the dated catalyst, and a story running ahead of profits. Note the price of $88.00 is a placeholder for dry-run purposes only — the engine fills at the live market price, never at a number I typed. Risks are enumerated in research/cbrs.md and are the reason it is capped at 8%.

COHR.note: Found by the emerging-theme radar (co-packaged optics). Forward P/E 35.20 BELOW trailing 79.09 - earnings expected to rise. Net income +1,530% y/y. Trades 26% below its 52-week high of $440, so this is not chasing a top.

ALAB.note: Highest absolute forward multiple bought so far (57.31x), but revenue +98.5% gives a growth-adjusted 0.58 - one of the best on the desk. Record quarter $392.4M (+104% y/y), Q3 guided $540-560M. Trades 36% below its 52-week high. Sized small because the absolute multiple leaves no room for a miss.

LITE.note: REJECTED - right theme, late vehicle. 52-week range $111.20 to $926.14; market cap +888% y/y. NVIDIA's $2B investment validated the thesis and the stock already paid it out. Also lossmaking (EPS -$92.96, net loss -$6.94B). Being right about a theme and buying it up 8x is still losing.

CLF.note: REJECTED - the perfect narrative and the wrong vehicle. Sole domestic producer of grain-oriented electrical steel for power transformers, which is a genuinely under-covered monopoly. But consensus target $11.80 is BELOW the $11.90 price (-0.8%), it is Hold-rated, and it is lossmaking. The GOES monopoly is a rounding error inside $19.2B of commodity steel revenue serving autos. A great theme needs a vehicle whose economics concentrate it.
